entries.title: Psalms 106:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Give ye thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; for his loving-kindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 106:2
segments: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah? [who] can shew forth all his praise?

entries.title: Psalms 106:3
segments: Blessed are they that keep justice, [and] he that doeth righteousness at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 106:4
segments: Remember me, O Jehovah, with [thy] favour toward thy people; visit me with thy salvation:

entries.title: Psalms 106:5
segments: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the joy of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 106:6
segments: ¶We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

entries.title: Psalms 106:7
segments: Our fathers in Egypt considered not thy wondrous works; they remembered not the multitude of thy loving-kindnesses; but they rebelled at the sea, at the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:8
segments: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make known his might.

entries.title: Psalms 106:9
segments: And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; and he led them through the deeps as through a wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 106:10
segments: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated [them], and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 106:11
segments: And the waters covered their oppressors: there was not one of them left.

entries.title: Psalms 106:12
segments: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:13
segments: ¶They soon forgot his works; they waited not for his counsel:

entries.title: Psalms 106:14
segments: And they lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted *God in the desert.

entries.title: Psalms 106:15
segments: Then he gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

entries.title: Psalms 106:16
segments: And they envied Moses in the camp, [and] Aaron, the saint of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 106:17
segments: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram;

entries.title: Psalms 106:18
segments: And fire was kindled in their company; a flame burned up the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 106:19
segments: They made a calf in Horeb, and did homage to a molten image;

entries.title: Psalms 106:20
segments: And they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

entries.title: Psalms 106:21
segments: They forgot *God their Saviour, who had done great things in Egypt,

entries.title: Psalms 106:22
segments: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, terrible things by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Psalms 106:23
segments: And he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses, his chosen, stood before him in the breach, to turn away his fury, lest he should destroy [them].

entries.title: Psalms 106:24
segments: And they despised the pleasant land; they believed not his word,

entries.title: Psalms 106:25
segments: But murmured in their tents: they hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 106:26
segments: And he lifted up his hand to them, that he would make them fall in the wilderness;

entries.title: Psalms 106:27
segments: And that he would make their seed fall among the nations, and disperse them through the countries.

entries.title: Psalms 106:28
segments: And they joined themselves unto Baal-Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead;

entries.title: Psalms 106:29
segments: And they provoked [him] to anger with their doings; and a plague broke out among them.

entries.title: Psalms 106:30
segments: Then stood up Phinehas and executed judgment, and the plague was stayed;

entries.title: Psalms 106:31
segments: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, from generation to generation, for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 106:32
segments: And they moved him to wrath at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with Moses on their account;

entries.title: Psalms 106:33
segments: For they provoked his spirit, so that he spoke unadvisedly with his lips.

entries.title: Psalms 106:34
segments: ¶They did not destroy the peoples, as Jehovah commanded them;

entries.title: Psalms 106:35
segments: But they mingled with the nations, and learned their works;

entries.title: Psalms 106:36
segments: And they served their idols; and they were a snare unto them:

entries.title: Psalms 106:37
segments: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

entries.title: Psalms 106:38
segments: And shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.

entries.title: Psalms 106:39
segments: And they were defiled with their works, and went a-whoring in their doings.

entries.title: Psalms 106:40
segments: Then was the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance;

entries.title: Psalms 106:41
segments: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them:

entries.title: Psalms 106:42
segments: And their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

entries.title: Psalms 106:43
segments: Often did he deliver them; but as for them they provoked [him] by their counsel, and they were brought low by their iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 106:44
segments: But he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry;

entries.title: Psalms 106:45
segments: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses;

entries.title: Psalms 106:46
segments: And he caused them to find compassion of all those that had carried them captives.

entries.title: Psalms 106:47
segments: Save us, Jehovah our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks unto thy holy name, [and] to triumph in thy praise.

entries.title: Psalms 106:48
segments: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel, from eternity and to eternity! And let all the people say, Amen! Hallelujah!
